name: Lucius Kaimana
source:
“There’s nobody else who cares about me in this realm other than you. Only we understand one another, Dear Sister.”

The brother of the protagonist and the future king of the Kaimana Kingdom. He’s always mindful of his sister, and hopes she’ll become more proactive. He appears to be an affable prince who takes his royal duties and responsibilities seriously. Though rumour has it, he's a touch too attached to his dearest sister.
